description.en: Custom DSH plugin market index for bundles built in this repository.
description.zh: 本仓库构建的 DSH 插件市场索引。

description.en: Claude-Desktop-style projects sidebar for DSH Desktop: group conversations into projects, keep per-conversation working directories, drag or use menus to move conversations/workspaces between projects, and permanently clean empty conversations.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供类似 Claude Desktop 的项目侧栏：把会话归入项目、为每个会话选择工作目录、拖拽或通过菜单在项目间迁移会话/工作区，并彻底清理空会话。

description.en: Split-screen Conversation View for DSH Desktop: arrange several live sessions side by side, stacked, in a 2x2 grid or a 3x3 grid. Drag sessions in from the sidebar, including the current one; each pane keeps its own transcript, composer, draft and attachment bar, and the resident header / right sidebar stay intact.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供分屏会话视图：把多个实时会话左右并排、上下、田字格或九宫格排列。左侧会话可直接拖入窗格（包括当前会话），每个窗格有独立的记录、输入框、草稿和附件栏，顶部信息栏与右侧栏保持原样。
